description: haiku-tier pf comparator (af_pf_baseline with model swapped; A118)
task_prompt_template:
Prove the theorem below by appending a proof to this exact file, then verify it with the check tool.

Rules, enforced by an external checker on the delivered file: the given prefix (imports, definitions, theorem statement) must stay EXACTLY as provided, character for character; never use admit, Admitted, Axiom, Parameter, Hypothesis, Variable, or extra Require — submissions containing them are rejected. When you believe the proof is complete and verified, reply DONE.

```coq
{prefix}```
